name: dsh-token-broadcast
description: Push the dsh session token plus the three entry addresses (LAN / Aliyun / Tailscale) to the phone's HarmonyOS assistant-today card whenever dsh starts, so it never has to be dug out of a log by hand. 1.1.0 (2026-09-30): card wording fixed by the user, and since Tailscale starts alongside dsh, a second card is pushed once the tailnet link comes up.
